images.caption: 500px provided description: Tivoli Vredenburg is Utrecht?s main cultural venue, a unique venue built for all kinds of music and entertainment. The large modern music palace harbours halls with perfect acoustics for hip hop, reggae, pop music, jazz, chamber music and dance, as well as cafes, bars, lounges and a restaurant. International acts like Sam Smith, Lorde, Major Lazer, and Placebo have rocked their House! images.caption: The Dom Tower in Utrecht, the Netherlands is one of the best known landmarks of this country. This gothic tower is the highest church tower (112,5 metres/368 feet) in the Netherlands and was built between 1321 and 1382 as part of the Cathedral of St. Martin. The resolution of the original photograph is 7768*4150.
